verdict.rationale: Snowflake documents official client libraries across multiple languages: drivers for JDBC, ODBC, Python, Go and Node.js, plus the Snowpark API for Python, Java and Scala and Snowflake ML APIs. It also publishes official OpenAPI-compliant REST API specs on GitHub so developers can build integrations in their language of choice, alongside the SQL API. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of building with the SDKs, deeper first-party detail on SDK coverage and versioning (evidence is mostly brief index-level mentions).
